metadata.description: Resources whose names use resourceGroup(). Pure (no other functions): resourceGroup().name and resourceGroup().location as managed-identity names. With other functions: uniqueString(resourceGroup().id) as a storage name, and format(resourceGroup().location, uniqueString(resourceGroup().id)). resourceGroup().id cannot be a name on its own (it is a slash-delimited path), so it is always wrapped.

resources.comments: PURE resourceGroup().name — no other functions (managed identity: allows hyphens)
resources.name: [resourceGroup().name]

resources.comments: resourceGroup().id WITH other functions — the canonical uniqueString(resourceGroup().id) storage pattern
resources.name: [concat('rgid', uniqueString(resourceGroup().id))]

resources.comments: COMBINED — resourceGroup().location + resourceGroup().id with format + uniqueString
resources.name: [format('rg-{0}-{1}', resourceGroup().location, uniqueString(resourceGroup().id))]
